scripts.gen-ts: cargo run -q -p harness-core --bin gen-ts -- packages/api/src/generated.ts && bun run gen-manifests
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '*' typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && bun run check-boundaries
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --locked
scripts.check:generated: bun run gen-ts && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api/src/generated.ts packages/*/manifest.json
